name: Better Enchantment Bookshelf Placement Mod
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Tokimi
description: This mod allows you to be able to spread out your bookshelves for your enchantment table layout. Have them floating around the table or even completely hidden from view.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
